description: Use when the user asks whether a specific flight will have WiFi or Starlink, which provider or aircraft it uses, or the odds of Starlink on a flight number. Returns a quotable answer line, the share of the last 60 days the flight used a verified Starlink aircraft, confidence (high, medium, low, none), last_observed, basis (observed_flights or airline_fleet), recent tails, and the predicted provider and tail for the date. Always the first choice for a flight number.

date.description: Flight date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

flight_number.description: IATA flight number, e.g. "UA123". "UA 123" and "ua-123" also work.

name: get_wifi_facts
title: WiFi on a flight
